items.label: Calculate immediately
items.description: On: a successful voice transcription is calculated immediately. Off: the recognized expression stays editable on the watch before you press equals.

items.label: Debug mode
items.description: When enabled, a voice calculation that cannot be parsed shows the complete raw transcription returned by Pebble dictation on the watch. Press Back to dismiss it.

items.defaultValue: Math parsing and evaluation are deterministic and run on the watch. Voice transcription itself uses Pebble's normal dictation flow through the paired phone.
